title: External Provenance Verification
description: Outer, non-cyclic verification of a human approval capture, D4 runtime/assembly attestation, D1.5 measurement, or P0/D5 lifecycle transition. A locally authored JSON/hash, transcript, or write log is never sufficient. trusted-runtime-query is permitted only while creating a non-W0 route artifact; every PV accepted by a W0 package or W0 run authorization must already use pinned-signature before its first immutable binding, and the W0 receiver performs no network query/send. pinned-signature requires cryptographic verification against an externally pinned trust anchor. Lifecycle transition claims must come from authority-side actual operation events, including zero/unlogged-write facts; merely re-signing the local attestation/log hash is invalid. Record-local verifier/authority/adapter/key strings are claims, not trust configuration. If required external signature verification is unavailable, transition is STOP/HUMAN.

verifier.description: Informational identity of the verifier. Receiver trust comes only from external pinned configuration, never these strings.

sourceArtifact.description: Original creation-time evidence: schema-valid trusted_runtime_query_result or pinned_signature_evidence. Actual bytes are rehashed and external config pins the adapter/key. W0-eligible records require pinned_signature_evidence at the owning stage; a query-only record is never upgraded during D5/W0 and forces STOP/rebuild.

claimsSha256.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(claims, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).

operatorExternalAbsolutePath.description: Resolved absolute operator-external path outside locked project/package/baseline/installed-Skill trees.

providerPolicy.description: Trusted authority's identity/digest for the provider-internal policy/runtime frame that enforced clean context and the filesystem boundary. A local prompt cannot self-assert this.

fullPromptSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact payload bytes explicitly submitted by the orchestrator for this lane. It must equal request/attestation fullPromptArtifact.sha256 and the trusted authority result; it does not claim provider-internal implicit frames.

inspectedInputsSha256.description: Digest of the path-sorted full inspectedInputs array using the canonical json.dumps algorithm.

revision.description: Lifecycle v1 transition baselines are snapshot-only.

capsuleAssemblyClaims.description: Externally returned actual assembly facts. They exact-match attestation/policy/runtime: resolved source root, candidate revision, complete tree, input/dependency digests, and SOURCE-STATE/REVISION/TREE argv, exits, raw outputs. Snapshot root equals revision.snapshotRoot; commit uses pinned Git and exact object.

presentationContentSha256.description: Must equal challenge.presentationArtifact.sha256 and the exact provider-authority message content hash.

requiredSubchecksSha256.description: Must equal both required_specs measurementContract and evidence.combinedSuite requiredSubchecksSha256.

subcheckEvidenceSetSha256.description: Must equal evidence.combinedSuite.subcheckEvidenceSetSha256 after the external authority derives every per-subcheck trial/threshold/raw-output binding.

combinedSuiteSha256.description: Canonical JSON SHA-256 of the complete non-empty combinedSuite object.

revision.description: Lifecycle v1 transition baselines are snapshot-only.

transitionSnapshotBinding.description: Authority actual full snapshot copy map/manifest/seal facts, exact-equal to the transition attestation.

sourceBaselineTreeSha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the exact source baseline manifest files projection [{path,bytes,sha256}, ...], not a complete unrelated project-tree claim.

stateSetSha256.description: Authority-observed canonical digest of sorted {path,exists,bytes,sha256} before states for every includeSet path of this role.

transitionMonitoringBinding.description: Authority-side monitor session/targets/start-state/scope. Must exact-equal the transition attestation, bind the source-baseline projection/fileSet plus all three role-specific includeSet before-state digests, cover canonical/product/ledger/private-staging/result mutations, and prevent other-root, partial-monitor, or replay acceptance. Approval evidence and fixed post-close proof artifacts are the only exclusions.

p0TransitionActualClaims.description: Authority-side actual P0 operation facts, exact-equal to attestation.claims. Monitoring identity/start state/scope covers B0 plus all staging/result/canonical targets. P0-start presentation/response/provenance precede all preapproval writes; inventory and procedural writes are separately counted/classified; authority-observed normalized payload precedes P0-contract presentation/response/provenance and fixed metadata. The single candidate freeze is followed only by one actual-candidate machine record, exact frozen-byte canonical apply events, and one final seal; candidate/staging mutation, refreeze, or any post-seal mutation is invalid. Zero-row inventory is explicitly zero/null while procedural writes remain provable.

d5TransitionActualClaims.description: Authority-side actual D5 operation facts, exact-equal to attestation.claims. Monitoring identity/start state/scope covers B1 and every canonical/staging/result target; D5 presentation/response/provenance precedes every sync write. After the final sync, the allowed-diff artifact and post-sync manifest are each logged once before the B2-manifest seal; no post-seal mutation is allowed. Complete parsed log, exact allowed-diff digest, B2 result, and no-unlogged-writes are mandatory.

w0RunAuthorizationClaims.description: Provider-signed actual human authorization interaction plus external one-time challenge consumption. scopeCoreSha256 exact-matches the pre-response scope object; distinct targetScopeSha256 exact-matches canonical {gateType,target,scope} and the challenge/canonical response. External claims prove challengeIssuedAt <= presentationAt < sentAt <= authorizedAt <= verifiedAt, exact assistant/system presentation bytes, exact human response bytes, and globally unique nonce/event consumption. Offline signature verification is mandatory.
